registry_root: Exact generic v1 writer and its outer field/version metadata; not an all-role writer grammar.

write_routes.scope: All originally authorized generic v1 kinds/tiers remain; accepted/receipt_kind/tier strings supply no Standard proof.

write_routes.producer_role: original Workflow controller or assigned canonical artifact owner through Storage
write_routes.scope: New authenticated Standard certification only, passing validators and no unresolved risk/exception/waiver; absent original key or exact original admitted v2 retry.

read_routes.standard_certification_proof: Original decision metadata only; current action, Goal availability and event proof remain separate.
read_routes.generic_projection_admission: Actual canonical v2 origin, exact version and currently installed generic reader authorization; preserve original generic meanings without Standard-proof authority or stored-row mutation.

unknown_route: Reject missing/unknown/uninstalled/withdrawn role or unsupported schema pair; never select by kind/tier string or silently validate every value against a union.
activation: Actual StorageMigrationCoordinator installs schemas, exact per-role dispatcher, current origin/backup/restore admission and dependent owners before enabling Standard capture/read. Existing generic gates validate v1 root only; no native installation is asserted.
